question: In Season 4 of the anime, the silhouette (character design) of Vague Adgard was revealed for the first time. How was that design decided? I'm curious whether it was devised by Mr. Otsuka, or whether you gave Mr. Otsuka a specific image of what you wanted from Natsuki-sensei.
answer:
That design was properly drawn up by Mr. Otsuka himself.

Of course, I already had Vague's setting in my head, but I had assumed he probably wouldn't appear in the main story. However, while we were having the anime script meetings, there came a point where we were going to touch upon the strongest individuals from each country. So I brought up the idea: “Wouldn't it be really cool if we could show even just the silhouettes of the strongest individuals from each country?”

Halibel and Cecilus already had designs, but Vague didn't. So I asked, “He's probably only going to appear here, but would it be okay to have Mr. Otsuka do his character design…?” And Mr. Otsuka was happy to draw him.

What's more, the national flags and coats of arms of each country were also designed for the first time at that stage. They flash by pretty quickly, so I really want you to pause the anime and take a look at them.

Kararagi has a cute coat of arms with a cute little cat casually tucked into it. As for the northern country of Gusteko, they have an extremely strong faith in spirits, and the Great Spirit OdGlass, who is the most revered of them all, is established as having an appearance resembling a polar bear, so Gusteko's coat of arms has a polar-bear-like design.

(Editor's note: The silhouettes of the strongest individuals from each country appear in Anime Season 4, Episode 72, “Julius Juukulius”!)
